brief: ここは実写画像にしてください。医療器具の画像などがいいかなと。
prompt: Photorealistic documentary still, 16:9 landscape. Close-up of a stainless steel medical instrument tray on a plain examination-room worktop, showing a few clean reusable stainless steel forceps and surgical scissors beside folded white gauze. A modest rural Japanese medical examination setting consistent with 1988. Restrained composition, slightly oblique overhead view, soft cool fluorescent lighting, muted natural colors, realistic metal reflections. The instruments and gauze are clearly visible, with the plain background gently out of focus and some uncluttered space for captions added during editing. This is a symbolic insert accompanying narration about a subsequent postmortem examination that identified massive blood loss. No people, hands, bodies, body parts, blood, wounds, active procedure, modern digital equipment, readable text, labels, logos, emblems, or watermarks. No dramatic horror lighting. Generate one image.
message: 指示した修正を反映しました。確認してください
